lowpoly.method: Decimate COLLAPSE per part on the welded high-poly copy, priority vertex group protects the face
lowpoly.why_not_quadriflow: QuadriFlow needs closed manifold input and smooths thin features: every Tripo part is one shell with 264-2413 open edges (segmentation cuts), and the figure is mostly thin feather sheets (wing primaries, crest spikes, collar ruff) whose serrated outline is the silhouette; collapse decimation keeps those outlines (measured: surface distance high->low per part in h2-lowpoly-report.json)

talons.preset_note: the preset library has no horn/claw class; the H2.1 talon rule (0.40-0.55, metallic 0) stays - it lies inside the keratin range of the feathers preset (0.40-0.75)

face_cavity.why: face islands (UV priority x2): base colour x (1 - 0.5 cavity - 0.6 dark detail), cavity = local AO deficit (gaussian 6 px of the 4K bake), dark detail = relative luminance below a 3 px blur (brows, lids, nostrils, lip line): darkening only, so the painted features keep their shape and survive the 2K mips at K2

base_parametric.azimuth_convention: degrees in the XY plane from +X counter-clockwise; -90 = -Y = the figure's front

clearance.note: every pip edge > min_m (XY) from any body vertex lower than band_m above the base top

pips.note: 3 sectors 120 deg apart, so for any yaw one sector faces the camera within ±60 deg. The talon tips reach r 8.4 uu (source r 0.127 x scale), the pips span r 8.65-10.45 uu on the flat top (r ≤ 10.6 uu). Pips are raised 0.04 uu with a 0.06 uu skirt (no z-fighting with the top); every pip exists in every instance, unlit pips take the base colour
pips.search_note: the H2 talons reach further out than the previous candidate's; the three pip sectors (120 deg apart) are turned by the offset (0..118 deg, step 2, preferring the one nearest the previous -90/30/150) with every pip edge > clearance.min_m from the feet in XY; smaller ring radii only if no offset clears

exposure_calibration.method: W4-A anchor (S08ArtBoardProfiles.json cobble-probe sky.calibration): K1 board ROI p50 of Rec.709 luma of the 8-bit sRGB frame = 131.2. Blender: figure and base hidden, calibration board 40 m (same albedo and roughness), K1 camera, exposure offset (stops, added to log2(1 / (1.2 * 2^EV100))) bisected until |p50 - target| <= tolerance; the offset is measured per run and recorded in preview/h3/review-frames-h3.json and reports/cobble-calibration.json
exposure_calibration.roi_source: tools/art/t42_sky_calib_editor.py BOARD_K1_BOX (x 600-1360, y 700-940 of the 1920x1080 frame)
exposure_calibration.cross_check: K2 5x board p50 of the final frames (figure-free corners) is reported next to the UE Cobble editor K2 5x board p50 129.4 of the Arthur H2.1 import frame (docs/art-pipeline/evidence/w5c-arthur-h2-ue-2026-09-29/arthur-h2-k2-5x-az0-blue-ue-editor.jpg)

cobble.warm_point_note: cobble-probe point 'warm' (85 cd at (260, -300, 250) uu, radius 450 uu, white): 470 uu from the board centre = outside its attenuation radius, not included
cobble.not_included: Lumen GI/reflections, CSM shadow filtering, TSR, the UE tonemapper, the warm point light, the stone texture and normal map of the board (flat plane of the mean albedo)
cobble.revision_note: rev 2 (defect fix): the rev 1 Cobble frames used the profile EV100 literally with no calibration and a 1.2 m board of albedo 0.18; the camera mostly saw the sky dome (luma 195) and the figure was bleached. rev 2 calibrates the exposure to the W4-A board anchor

slivers.why: boundary edges with both ends on a neighbour's boundary vertices but another path between them (stitch skipped the insertion, max_edge_factor): the sliver is filled by a fan of the part

lips.why: non-shared boundary edges within 2.5 mm of another part get a lip to 0.5 mm past the neighbour

core.name: core_103
core.why: closed occluder inside head/torso/thighs/tail: a ray that slips through a crack between parts meets its front face (one dark texel of the tail island) instead of culled back faces

exposed.why: triangles whose back side is seen from a game direction (the ray to the camera escapes) get a detached reversed copy (H2.1 method)

base_material.note: H2.1 metal base (proposal; UE not touched): the parametric base keeps its mesh, pips and vertex mask; UV0 re-laid by base_gold.uv_layout, own 1K texture set T_Harpy_H2_Base_{BC,N,ORM} (base_textures.py). UE route: M_UM_BaseMarker MI with BaseColorTexture/NormalTexture/ORMTexture = these, BaseColor (1,1,1), VertexMaskWeight 1 (team band + pips from the vertex mask), SideBandWeight 0, BandKeepsTexture 0, PipColor / PipEmissive as before. M_UM_BaseMarker takes Metallic = ORM.B and Roughness = lerp(RoughnessMin, RoughnessMax, ORM.G), so the texture carries the metal

top.why: antique gold / bronze leaf of the concept base (concept front, base median sRGB (0.66, 0.50, 0.26) = linear (0.39, 0.21, 0.06) as lit); kept darker than the lit pips (instance read: pip - top >= 40 luma, analyse_instances.py). H3: roughness from the preset gold_antique (typical 0.30 +- 0.08); the COLOUR stays the dark antique tone of H2.1, not the preset F0: measured on the harpy-h3-bake/1 draft 2026-09-29, the preset F0 gold top (1.0, 0.766, 0.336) broke the instance-pip read (analyse_instances.py: 4 of 6 frame sets NOT ALL, lit pips miscounted) - game readability of the pips (pip - top >= 40 luma) wins over the preset colour here

band.why: H3: preset gold_antique (docs/art-pipeline/material-library/um-material-presets-v1.json): F0 gold [1.0, 0.766, 0.336], luminance variation 0.12, roughness typical 0.30 +- variation 0.08 inside range [0.2, 0.42], no patina (the preset has none). Shows only with BandKeepsTexture 1; the default flat team band takes its ORM
